_warning: DO NOT EDIT IN dist/ — this is the SOURCE registry consumed by deriveExternalConsumers() in cloud-data-config-derive.ts. Edit this file to add/modify external consumers (non-cloud-container services in other repos that need a slice of _cloud-data-consolidated.json).

_meta.description: External-consumers registry. Each entry produces one 1_cloud-configs/dist/build-{name}.json containing the declared slices of _cloud-data-consolidated.json. Mirror of the per-container `deriveContainerConfigs` pattern, extended to non-container services in unix/ + cloud-data/ + similar repos.
_meta.consumer_repo_pattern: External consumer repos pick up their build file via a sync step in their build.sh. Recommended pattern: cp ~/git/cloud/1_cloud-configs/dist/build-{name}.json <consumer_repo>/build-{name}.json (or symlink at clone time).

consumers.name: flakes_desktop
consumers.description: Home-manager desktop flake (~/git/unix/ba_flakes_desktop). Activates on dev laptops, Surface, and any non-VM workstation.

consumers.name: flakes_termux
consumers.description: Home-manager Termux flake (~/git/unix/bb_flakes_termux). Activates on Android via nix-on-droid; subset of desktop (no WG, no docker).

consumers.name: builders
consumers.description: Container-builder images (~/git/unix/cb_containers-builders). Builds the cloud-builder-x docker image used by GHA + local ship runs.
replaces: cloud-data-gha-config.json (vm wg_ip/host/user lookup + service matrix for ship-services.sh)

consumers.name: secrets
consumers.description: Secrets pipeline (~/git/cloud-data/secrets/). Decrypts SOPS yaml per service into per-service env files.
replaces: cloud-data-secrets-env-var-names.json (per-service required env var names list)
